Predictive check against simulated responses

pp_check.frmtmb_fit.Rd

The frequentist analog of brms's pp_check(): responses are simulated from the fitted model (marginally over the random effects) and handed to the corresponding bayesplot ppc_* function. Requires bayesplot; call as bayesplot::pp_check(fit) or load bayesplot first.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'frmtmb_fit'
pp_check(object, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 10, re.form = NA, ...)

Arguments

object

A frmtmb_fit for a univariate model.

type

The bayesplot check, i.e. the part after ppc_ ("dens_overlay", "hist", "stat", "scatter_avg", ...).

ndraws

Number of simulated response vectors.

re.form

Passed to simulate(); the default NA simulates new random effects.

...

Passed to the ppc_* function.
